reviewer: Owner decision 2026-09-09 (Loïc): sub-labels stay distinct; relation attested by the native page sameAs, recorded not merged — Claude

evidence.statement: hub-urbn.icims.com is the group career portal of URBN; each posting page names its hiring organization. FP Movement (sameAs freepeople.com/fpmovement), Anthro Weddings (anthropologie.com/bhldn-weddings) and Maeve (anthropologie.com/maeve) are kept as distinct employer labels; the page attests their relation to Free People and Anthropologie, which is recorded and does not merge identities (owner decision 2026-09-09).
The official URBN "Our Brands" page presents FP Movement within Free People and Anthropologie among the group brands; Anthro Weddings and Maeve are Anthropologie labels per their posting pages.
